extract: Harandar is a zone introduced in World of Warcraft: Midnight. A bioluminscent primordial jungle, it is an underground cavern where the roots of all World Trees on Azeroth converge, and home to the haranir. The Rift of Aln is also located here.

{{Neutral}} [[Har'kuai]] | minor ={{Neutral}} [[Fungara Village]] | faiths = [[Azeroth (titan)|Aln'hara]] worship | loc = }} '''Harandar''' is a [[zone]] introduced in ''[[World of Warcraft: Midnight]]''. A bioluminscent primordial jungle,{{ref web|url=https://blizzardwatch.com/2025/08/21/get-losers-going-back-quelthalas-zones-midnight/|title=Get in losers, we’re going back to Quel’Thalas (and other zones) in Midnight|author=Liz Patt|publisher=Blizzard Watch|date=2025-08-31|accessdate=2025-09-02}} it is an underground cavern where the roots of all [[World Tree]]s on [[Azeroth]] converge, and home to the [[haranir]].[https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/midnight World of Warcraft: Midnight website] The [[Rift of Aln]] is also located here.{{Ref web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eHa5CDWYtXg|title=World of Midnight Developer Panel - gamescom 2025|author=World of Warcraft|publisher=YouTube|date=2025-08-21|accessdate=2025-08-21}} ==Maps and subregions== [[File:VZ-Harandar.jpg|thumb|Zone map]] {| class="darktable hlist" | *[[Abundant Grotto]] *[[Ahl'ua Wetland]] *[[Amirdrassil Roots]] *[[Blooming Lattice]] *[[Blossoming Terrace]] *[[Den of Echoes]] *[[Dreth'amar Cavern]] *[[Encroaching Bloom]] *[[Fungal Cleft]] *[[Fungara Village]] *[[Glade of Walking Memories]] *[[Glimmering Cataract]] *[[Gloom Mire]] *[[Har'alnor]] *[[Har'alnor Den]] *[[Har'athir]] *[[Har'kuai]] *[[Har'mara]] *[[Jungle Cascades]] *[[Nai'theren Grotto]] *[[Nordrassil Roots]] *[[Rift of Aln]] *[[Shrine of Ages]] *[[Shrouded Grove]] *[[Stillroot Basin]] *[[Teldrassil Roots]] *[[Blinding Bloom|The Blinding Bloom]] *[[Cradle|The Cradle]] *[[Den (Harandar)|The Den]] *[[Gulf of Memory|The Gulf of Memory]] *[[Grudge Pit|The Grudge Pit]] *[[Shadow Cleft|The Shadow Cleft]] *[[Tangleknot|The Tangleknot]] *[[Vale of Mists]] *[[Vale of Secrets]] *[[Veilroot Clearing]] *[[Verdant Sepulcher]] *[[Nihil]] |} File:WorldMap-MicroDungeon-Rootlands Micro Mega a.jpg File:WorldMap-MicroDungeon-Rootlands Micro Mega b.jpg ==Trivia== *Harandar is speculated to be a rework of the cut "Rootlands" zone that was part of the [[InstanceID]] list for [[Khaz Algar]] but had no corresponding terrain. The [[great roots]] may have connected. **The Rootlands is used in some descriptions in {{g|mn}} to refer to Harandar. **The Rootlands was also used in the name of several items relating to Harandar during Midnight's alpha and beta. *Unlike other world trees, [[Vordrassil]]'s roots do not reach Harandar. They were intentionally severed due to the tree's corruption reaching deep within its roots.[[Kawayn#Gossip]] ==Gallery== File:Harandar key art.jpg|Harandar key art.
